posts.text: The FIA has approved five new 2027 operational regulations to keep non-F1 staff away from F1 projects. Non-F1 staff will be barred from the F1 factory, and staff who leave a team must wait at least a year to return. https://www.motorsport.com/f1/news/fia-enforces-new-rule-to-close-f1-cost-cap-loophole/10866642/
